title: Default EPS bearer context activation initiated by the network

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context activation
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to activate a default EPS bearer context. The MME sends ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and enters BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to initiate default EPS bearer context activation. Contains EPS bearer identity, PTI, and Access Point Name IE.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to accept the default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject the default EPS bearer context activation.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State entered by MME after sending ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST, waiting for UE response.

entities.name: T3485
entities.description: Timer started by MME when sending ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST in stand-alone PDN connectivity procedure.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identity assigned by MME for the EPS bearer, included in ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: PTI
entities.description: Procedure Transaction Identity retrieved from PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message, included in ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: Access Point Name IE
entities.description: Information element containing both network identifier and operator identifier parts, included in ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST.

entities.name: During attach procedure
entities.description: Condition when default bearer activation is part of attach procedure. MME sends ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST with ATTACH ACCEPT and does not start T3485.

entities.name: Stand-alone PDN connectivity request
entities.description: Condition when default bearer activation is in response to stand-alone PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST. MME sends ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST alone and starts T3485.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
The procedure requires entering BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state after sending the request.
The message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
The message contains Access Point Name IE.
During stand-alone PDN connectivity, MME starts timer T3485.
Receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT stops timer T3485.
Receiving ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT stops timer T3485.
During attach procedure, MME does not start timer T3485.
